adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the Lark token refresh path now calls `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. When sync is enabled (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId`), `refreshOAuthTokens` returns the raw `fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, ...)` response (per `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`). Immediately after, the code passes that response into `handleLarkError<RefreshTokenResp>(resp, ...)`, which (by its name and usage) is intended to validate/unwrap Lark’s refresh response shape (`RefreshTokenResp`), not an arbitrary sync endpoint response. The helper itself documents the sync endpoint response as “only contain the access token and expiry date”, which is incompatible with a Lark-specific envelope handler. This makes the Lark refresh flow break under credential sync mode.
